name: RealConstraint
stmt:
structure RealConstraint where
  a : ℝ
  b : ℝ

name: RealConstraintSat
stmt: def RealConstraintSat (c : RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) : Prop

name: RealNeuron
stmt:
structure RealNeuron where
  w : ℝ
  b : ℝ

name: RealNeuronOut
stmt: def RealNeuronOut (n : RealNeuron) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

name: convertReal
stmt: def convertReal (c : RealConstraint) : RealNeuron

name: convertReal_preserves
stmt:
theorem convertReal_preserves (c : RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) :
    RealConstraintSat c x ↔ RealNeuronOut (convertReal c) x = 0

name: realLoss
stmt: def realLoss (c : RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) : ℝ

name: realLoss_soundness
stmt:
theorem realLoss_soundness (c : RealConstraint) (x : ℝ) :
    realLoss c x = 0 ↔ RealConstraintSat c x
proof:
by
  unfold realLoss
  rw [sq_eq_zero_iff]
  exact (convertReal_preserves c x).symm

name: real_sq_sum_zero_iff
stmt: theorem real_sq_sum_zero_iff (a b : ℝ) : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 0 ↔ a = 0 ∧ b = 0
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro h
    have ha2 : a ^ 2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
    have hb2 : b ^ 2 = 0 := by
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg a, sq_nonneg b]
    exact ⟨sq_eq_zero_iff.mp ha2, sq_eq_zero_iff.mp hb2⟩
  · intro h
    rcases h with ⟨ha, hb⟩
    simp [ha, hb]

name: real_scale_preserves
stmt:
theorem real_scale_preserves (c : RealConstraint) (x lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) :
    RealConstraintSat c x ↔ RealConstraintSat { a := c.a * lam, b := c.b * lam } x
proof:
by
  unfold RealConstraintSat
  constructor
  · intro h
    calc
      (c.a * lam) * x + (c.b * lam) = (c.a * x + c.b) * lam := by ring
      _ = 0 * lam := by rw [h]
      _ = 0 := by simp
  · intro h
                   
    have hinv : (c.a * x + c.b) * lam = 0 := by
      calc
        (c.a * x + c.b) * lam = (c.a * lam) * x + (c.b * lam) := by ring
        _ = 0 := h
                   
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hinv).resolve_right hlam

name: realDot_scale
stmt:
theorem realDot_scale {ι : Type*} [Fintype ι] (a x : ι → ℝ) (lam : ℝ) :
    RealDot (fun i => a i * lam) x = (RealDot a x) * lam
proof:
by
  unfold RealDot
  rw [Finset.sum_mul]
  apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
  intro i hi
  ring

name: realVec_scale_preserves
stmt:
theorem realVec_scale_preserves {ι : Type} [Fintype ι] (c : RealVectorConstraint ι) (x : ι → ℝ)
    (lam : ℝ) (hlam : lam ≠ 0) :
    RealVectorSat c x ↔ RealVectorSat { a := fun i => c.a i * lam, b := c.b * lam } x
proof:
by
  unfold RealVectorSat
  rw [realDot_scale]
  constructor
  · intro h
    calc
      (RealDot c.a x) * lam + c.b * lam = (RealDot c.a x + c.b) * lam := by ring
      _ = 0 * lam := by rw [h]
      _ = 0 := by simp
  · intro h
    have hsum : (RealDot c.a x + c.b) * lam = 0 := by
      calc
        (RealDot c.a x + c.b) * lam = (RealDot c.a x) * lam + c.b * lam := by ring
        _ = 0 := h
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp hsum).resolve_right hlam

end Lattice

name: CongruentInt
stmt: def CongruentInt (x a m : ℤ) : Prop

name: ModSinLoss
stmt: def ModSinLoss (x a m : ℤ) : ℝ

name: pi_ne_zero
stmt: lemma pi_ne_zero : π ≠ 0

name: sin_int_mul_pi_zero
stmt: lemma sin_int_mul_pi_zero (n : ℤ) : Real.sin (n * π) = 0

name: sin_eq_zero_iff_int
stmt: lemma sin_eq_zero_iff_int (θ : ℝ) : Real.sin θ = 0 ↔ ∃ n : ℤ, θ = n * π
proof:
by
  constructor
  · intro hs
    rcases (Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mp hs) with ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact ⟨n, hn.symm⟩
  · rintro ⟨n, hn⟩
    exact Real.sin_eq_zero_iff.mpr ⟨n, hn.symm⟩

name: modSinLoss_of_congruent
stmt:
theorem modSinLoss_of_congruent (x a m : ℤ) (h : CongruentInt x a m) :
    ModSinLoss x a m = 0
proof:
by
  unfold ModSinLoss CongruentInt at *
  rcases h with ⟨k, hk⟩
                                       
  by_cases hm : (m : ℝ) = 0
  ·                                                     
    have hmz : m = 0 := Int.cast_eq_zero.mp hm
    have hx : (x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ) = 0 := by
      have : x - a = 0 := by simpa [hmz] using hk
      exact_mod_cast this
    simp [hx, hm]
  ·                                     
    have hxma : ((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) := by
      have hkR : ((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) = ((m * k : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
        exact_mod_cast hk
      rw [hkR, Int.cast_mul]
      simpa [mul_comm] using mul_div_cancel_right₀ (k : ℝ) hm
                                        
    rw [mul_div_assoc, hxma]
                   
    have hs : Real.sin (π * (k : ℝ)) = 0 := by
                                      
      have : π * (k : ℝ) = (k : ℝ) * π := by ring
      rw [this]
      exact sin_int_mul_pi_zero k
    simp [hs]

name: congruent_of_modSinLoss_zero
stmt:
theorem congruent_of_modSinLoss_zero (x a m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0)
    (h : ModSinLoss x a m = 0) : CongruentInt x a m
proof:
by
  unfold ModSinLoss CongruentInt at *
  have hmR : (m : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast hm
                            
  have hs : Real.sin (π * ((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ)) = 0 := by
    have : (Real.sin (π * ((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ))) ^ 2 = 0 := by simpa using h
    exact sq_eq_zero_iff.mp this
                             
  rcases (sin_eq_zero_iff_int _).mp hs with ⟨n, hn⟩
                                         
  have hdiv : ((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) := by
                       
    have hπmul : π * (((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ)) = π * (n : ℝ) := by
      calc
        π * (((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ)) = π * ((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ) := by
          rw [mul_div_assoc']
        _ = (n : ℝ) * π := by
          simpa using hn
        _ = π * (n : ℝ) := by ring
    exact mul_left_cancel₀ pi_ne_zero hπmul
                                        
  have hxma : (x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ) = (n : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) := by
    calc
      (x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ) = (((x : ℝ) - (a : ℝ)) / (m : ℝ)) * (m : ℝ) := by
        rw [div_mul_cancel₀ _ hmR]
      _ = (n : ℝ) * (m : ℝ) := by rw [hdiv]
                                   
  have hint : x - a = n * m := by
    have hc : ((x - a : ℤ) : ℝ) = ((n * m : ℤ) : ℝ) := by
      simpa using hxma
    exact Int.cast_inj.mp hc
  exact ⟨n, by simpa [mul_comm] using hint⟩

name: modSinLoss_zero_iff_congruent
stmt:
theorem modSinLoss_zero_iff_congruent (x a m : ℤ) (hm : m ≠ 0) :
    ModSinLoss x a m = 0 ↔ CongruentInt x a m
proof:
by
  constructor
  · exact congruent_of_modSinLoss_zero x a m hm
  · exact modSinLoss_of_congruent x a m

end

end Lattice
